title: An Analysis of Dataset Overlap on Winograd-Style Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the degree of overlap between common-sense reasoning test instances and language model pretraining corpora by parsing test instances into a skeletal representation and computing BM25 retrieval scores.

Evaluating existing Winograd-style benchmarks for predictable syntactic structures and exploitable word associations, and mitigating these artifacts by scraping structurally complex, naturally occurring pronoun disambiguation problems from web text.
